## How was it checked?

Tell us what you ran and where — Windows, Linux, or both. For a change to overlay, launch or deployment, say whether you tried it on a real game installation.

## Before merging

- [ ] `bun run lint` and `bun test` pass.
- [ ] `bun run check:rust` passes if Rust code changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for user-visible changes.
